name: popsicle
headline: AI tools for GTM funnels
short_description: A curated list of AI agents and tools for building autonomous Go-to-Market (GTM) funnels - from ideation to customer success.
author: hculap

sections.overview:
Awesome AI GTM is a comprehensive collection of AI agents and tools designed to build complete, autonomous Go-to-Market funnels across every stage: ideation and strategy, marketing and content creation, sales and conversion, pipeline management, and customer success. The repository organizes tools across multiple functional areas including ideation, market research, content strategy, lead prospecting, email outreach, sales enablement, and customer support. It serves product teams, marketers, sales leaders, and entrepreneurs who want to understand how AI agents work together to automate complex GTM workflows, replacing traditional point solutions with integrated, multi-step processes.
Map the complete AI GTM stack for your organization
Identify AI agents for specific funnel stages (ideation, marketing, sales, support)
Research market research and competitive intelligence tools
Discover content creation and SEO strategy automation solutions
sections.setup:

```
Generate a list of 5 AI agents and tools that can help [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] industry build an autonomous GTM funnel. Include tools for ideation, lead generation, content creation, sales automation, and customer success. Provide a brief description of each tool's capabilities and how it fits into the GTM process.
```
